object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Start a comparison, then change From and start another before the first finishes, holding the first so that it finishes last. Expected: the rows, counts and versions shown are those of the second comparison, and the first's result is never shown. Start several comparisons in quick succession: only the last one's result is shown. Start a comparison and type in From without pressing Enter or Compare: the result of the comparison running isn't shown.
